summary: Tested DOCX download functionality for resumes and cover letters. Found and fixed a regex bug in docxDownload.js. Downloads now working correctly - both resume and cover letter DOCX files are generated and downloaded successfully.

fixed_issues.issue: Invalid regex character class in safeFilename function
fixed_issues.explanation: The hyphen in the character class was creating an invalid range. Changed to \x00-\x1F to properly match control characters.

passed_tests: Frontend: Applications page loads with authenticated user
Frontend: 'View saved documents' button expands to show Resume and Cover Letter sections
Frontend: 'Download .docx' buttons visible for both Resume and Cover Letter
Frontend: Resume download triggers correctly - blob size 9995 bytes
Frontend: Cover letter download triggers correctly - blob size 8964 bytes
Frontend: Downloaded files are valid DOCX (start with PK signature)
Frontend: Console logs show successful download flow without errors
Frontend: file-saver saveAs function is being called correctly
critical_code_review_comments: The original regex /[<>:"/\\|?*-\x1F]/g had an invalid character class - the hyphen between * and \x1F was interpreted as a range operator, not a literal hyphen. Fixed by using \x00-\x1F to properly match control characters.
seed_data_creation: Used existing application with optimized resume and cover letter
context_for_next_testing_agent: DOCX download functionality is working correctly. The client-side generation using 'docx' and 'file-saver' libraries creates valid DOCX files. Fixed a regex bug in safeFilename function. Test with session token WB-eSNKB0PwgIkBMRN41tDo1PUjebG-GYRiXrSHMXAw.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Invalid regex character class in safeFilename function. The regex /[<>:"/\\|?*-\x1F]/g had a hyphen between * and \x1F which was interpreted as a range operator (from * to \x1F), not a literal hyphen. This caused 'Range out of order in character class' error.
reproduction_steps: 4. Observe error in console: 'Invalid regular expression: Range out of order in character class'
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Changed regex from /[<>:"/\\|?*-\x1F]/g to /[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1F]/g to properly match control characters (\x00-\x1F) instead of an invalid range.
